title: A psychedelic audio reactive runner brought to life from my wife's drawings
author: HexshroomGame
selftext:
I've been working on this for about 3 months and I'm really proud of it. My wife hand-drew all the art, and I turned it into 3D models with Meshy and Tripo. It's amazing how those tools let me bring her work to life. I started off the coding in AI Studio and later moved to Claude.

I've wanted to make games since I was a kid, but life happens, and it never seemed realistic. Then about 3 months ago, home with my 2-year-old, I realized I barely leave the house anymore and needed something to stimulate my mind between nursery rhymes and repetitive kids' games.

Enter Hexshroom, a project I got way more obsessed with than I ever expected. It combines my favorite things: EDM, psychedelic art and arcade games. Every level is built from its song, and the visuals react to the music.

There are 8 characters and 4 worlds so far, with more if people enjoy it. I plan to release on Steam eventually, but I'd love more playtesting, so any feedback is appreciated!

Desktop and headphones recommended, mobile fully supported. Play free: https://hexshroom.com

comments.author: czumiu
comments.body: The collectible SFX keeps rising in pitch until it hits a high pitched noise. What if it used the Shepard tone illusion?

replies.author: HexshroomGame
replies.body: That's not a bad  idea I'll definitely test it out.

comments.author: Opening_Wafer_6584
comments.body:
Hey, Alex here from the Tripo Studio US team. Really like the fact that the 3D is coming from your wife’s original drawings rather than the visual direction being generated from scratch.

That makes me curious about the conversion step. Between Meshy and Tripo, how much work are you doing after generation to preserve the proportions/style of the drawings once they become 3D?

For something this visually specific, I imagine consistency across the 8 characters is probably pretty important.

Also congrats on getting it playable after only three months.

replies.author: HexshroomGame
replies.body: Thanks for giving it a try!
